intent: Illustrate a field botanist labeling a seed tray in a small greenhouse.
composition: Landscape view at bench height. Put the botanist on the left and the seed tray in the foreground.
lighting: Soft morning light through the roof glass.

anchors.detail: The botanist has a chin-length silver bob and wears round amber glasses.
A moss-green apron with a single square chest pocket.
Narrow teal window frames and a pale wooden potting bench.
Linocut printed with flat inks, broad carved hatch marks and exposed cream paper.

constraints: Use exactly six seed pots in two rows of three.
